visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a broad, snow-covered mountain slope under a clear, bright blue sky with the sun shining brightly. A person wearing a grey and white camo-patterned winter jacket, black snow pants, a grey helmet, and goggles is standing on a dark snowboard, facing away from the camera. They initiate movement, sliding down the groomed trail toward distant snow-capped mountains. (2) The camera moves in a tracking follow shot behind the snowboarder as they carve through the white powdery snow, leaning slightly to the side with arms extended for balance. To the right, a line of thin, leafless trees borders the slope, and a ski lift with empty chairs hangs stationary against the backdrop of a forested hillside. (3) The snowboarder continues their descent, approaching the base of the mountain where a large wooden lodge and several smaller buildings are situated. Numerous other figures in various colorful winter gear are visible, some standing and others moving slowly across the flat area. The lighting is strong and natural, creating long, soft shadows on the textured snow surface.
